contexts.text: Unless an opportunity were given to (evil Spirits) to disparage the truth, nay to blaspheme it, they could not live. (Because this is their food.)
The lot of those (who have blasphemed the Word) is miserable... according to the degree of the blasphemy...
The children who were torn to pieces by the bears () represented those who revile the Word...
At last he rejects (heavenly things), and then so far as is allowable, reviles them.
Would rush... into blasphemies against those things which are of faith...
Reasonings from falsified truths are at last turned into blasphemies against truth and good.
To blaspheme the name of Jehovah () = by means of malevolent falsities to do violence to the truths and goods which are of worship.
A sore breaking forth with pustules () = filthy things with blasphemies therefrom.
He who blasphemes God is insane...
In yielding during temptations there is the blaspheming of truth and good...
Thou shalt not take the name of thy God in vain = profanations and blasphemings of the truth and good of faith.
Blaspheming takes place when the things of the Word or of the doctrine of faith, thus which are holy, are held in derision, and are dragged down to unclean earthly things, and so defiled.
He who smiteth his father and his mother () = the blaspheming of the Lord and His kingdom. To smite = to injure by means of falsities, and when predicated of the Lord and His kingdom = to blaspheme.
Thou shalt not revile God () = that truths Divine are not to be blasphemed... for they who blaspheme also revile.
And the prince among thy people thou shalt not execrate () = that neither is the doctrine of truth to be blasphemed.

Truth Divine is the Word, and it is doctrine from the Word. They who deny it at heart, blaspheme it, even although they praise and preach it with the lips. Blasphemy lies concealed in denial, and also breaks forth when they are thinking by themselves, especially in the other life...
They who blaspheme or deny the Word can receive nothing of the truth and good of faith...
If man could see what great and fearful blasphemies against the Word exist in those who are in the evils of these loves, he would be horrified...

Blasphemies are of two kinds. There are those which come forth from the Intellectual and not at the same time from the Voluntary, and those which come forth from the Voluntary through the Intellectual. These latter are the blasphemies which are so horrible; not the former. Explained.
The blasphemy against the Holy Spirit () is blasphemy against the Divine of the Lord; that against the Son of Man, is something against the Word, by giving a wrong interpretation.
Every love has its own delights... as... with the worst men, the love of blaspheming the holy things of the Church...
To love the neighbour... is not to revile him.
He who is in the love of domineering from selflove thinks nothing of... reviling the neighbour.
The blasphemy of those who say they are Jews () = the falsehood that with them are the goods of love... Blasphemy, here, = falsehood.

Upon his heads the name of blasphemy () = the denial of the Lord's Divine Human, and the doctrine of the Church not hatched from the Word, but from their Own intelligence. The seven heads = insanity from mere falsities, and this insanity speaks blasphemy when it denies the Divine of the Lord in His Human, and also when it does not take the doctrine of the Church from the Word, but hatches it from its Own intelligence.

As to the first statement, that blasphemy is to deny the Divine of the Lord in His Human, this is so because he who denies it is against the faith received in the universal Christian world, called the Athanasian... wherefore they who deny the Divine in His Human are not far from the Socinians and Arians.

As to the second statement, that blasphemy is not to take doctrine from the Word, but to hatch it from man's Own intelligence, this is so because the Church is from the Word, and is according to the understanding of the Word it has...

Blasphemy () = to deny the Divine of the Lord, as the Socinians do, and to deny the Word; for they who thus deny the Divine of the Lord cannot enter Heaven, for the Divine of the Lord is all in all things of Heaven; and he who denies the Word, denies all things of religion.
There was given him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies () = that they teach evils and falsities... Blasphemies = the truths of the Word falsified, thus falsities...

He opened his mouth in blasphemies against God and His name () = their sayings, which are stumbling blocks against the Lord's Divine itself and Divine Human, and at the same time against everything of the Church from the Word by means of which the Lord is worshipped... Blasphemies = falsifications of the Word, and many other things; here, also stumbling blocks, because there follows against God and His name.

They blasphemed the name of God, Who has Power over these plagues () = ... that they did not acknowledge the Divinity of the Lord's Human... To blaspheme the name of God = to deny, or not to acknowledge the Divinity of the Lord's Human, or the holiness of the Word. To blaspheme = to deny, or not to acknowledge.
To blaspheme the God of Heaven () = to deny or not to acknowledge the Lord alone as the God of Heaven and earth. AR 715.

Full of names of blasphemy () = the Word profaned by them... Blasphemy = the denial of the Lord's Divine in His Human, and the adulteration of the Word, thus profanation. For he who does not acknowledge the Lord's Divine in His Human, and falsifies the Word, but not of set purpose, does indeed profane, but slightly. Whereas they who ascribe to themselves all the power of the Lord's Divine Human, and on that account deny it, and who apply all things of the Word to the acquisition of dominion over the holy things of the Church and of Heaven, and on that account adulterate the Word, profane grievously.

To take the name of God in vain means to take anything (from what the Church teaches from the Word, and by means of which the Lord is invoked and worshipped), [and use it] in vain talk, falsehoods, lies, execrations, sorceries, and enchantments, for this also is to revile and blaspheme God, thus His name.

In the celestial sense, to take the name of God in vain means what the Lord said to the Pharisees; All sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven to man, but the blasphemy of the Spirit shall not be forgiven (). The blasphemy of the Spirit means blasphemy against the Divinity of the Lord's Human, and against the holiness of the Word.
In the celestial sense, to bear false witness means to blaspheme the Lord and the Word, and thus to utterly destroy truth itself out of the Church...
He then thinks nothing of revilings, which are also false witness...
The utterances (of such) are nothing but blasphemies against the Holy Spirit.
The dragon blaspheming.
The blasphemy of those who say they are Jews = invective uttered by those who suppose themselves to be in Knowledges of good and truth... blasphemy = vituperation and invective.
Upon his heads the name of blasphemy = falsifications of the Word. Explained and Example(s).

The Divine is also blasphemed through the falsification of the Word by their believing and thinking that God the Father wanted to be reconciled to the human race through the last penalty of condemnation, which was the passion of the cross, and thus through the blood of His Son... What is contrary to the Divine is blasphemy. Hence also to draw the sense of the letter of the Word to confirm it is blasphemy.
The sin and blasphemy against the Holy Spirit is to deny the Word, also to adulterate its very goods and falsify its very truths. Explained, Example(s).
Names of blasphemy () = adulterations of the good and falsifications of the truth of the Word, which are blasphemies against the Lord. AE 1039.
That blasphemies = to believe and to speak evilly and falsely about God and Divine truth, Illustrated.

In human languages, as also in the Hebrew, there are various words by which blasphemings of God and Divine truth are expressed; as in Latin, calumnies, reproaches, ignominies, taunts, revilings, vituperations, witty sayings, mockings, jeers, and many more...

There was given him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies = doctrine destroying the goods of the Word, and deeply destroying its truths... To speak blasphemies = to falsify the truths of the Word.

And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God = the falsification of Divine truth, thus of the Word which is from the Lord and which is the Lord... Blasphemy = the falsification of the Word even to the destruction of Divine truth such as there is in Heaven. Explained. AE 798. AE 984. AE 991.
To blaspheme God () = to falsify the Word.
The blasphemy against the Holy Spirit, which cannot be forgiven is the blaspheming of the Word by those who deny its holiness.
